title: The Accident That Invented Steel
description:
Steel wasn't invented on purpose. Ancient smiths heated soft iron in charcoal for hours, a little carbon soaked in, and the metal came out harder and sharper.

The oldest known steel was found at Kaman-Kalehöyük in Turkey and dates to about 1800 BC. Smiths in southern India later made famous wootz steel.

Sources:
- Akanuma, H. (2005), Anatolian Archaeological Studies 14: iron fragments from Kaman-Kalehöyük
- World History Encyclopedia: Twelve Steels That Forged History
- Ferrous metallurgy overview (carburization, wootz steel)
